data.gemini_allow_gemma: Allow Gemma overflow when daily quota is exhausted

data_description.vlm_provider: Ollama runs locally and keeps frames on your network. The Gemini API is much faster and more accurate, but sends screenshots of whatever is on your TV to Google.
data_description.gemini_api_key: Required when the Gemini provider is selected. Free-tier keys are metered per model; the integration rotates across Flash-Lite models automatically.
data_description.gemini_escalate: When Flash-Lite cannot identify the content, retry once on the higher-quality Flash tier (about 100 requests per day).
data_description.gemini_allow_gemma: Gemma has a very large daily allowance but takes about 30 seconds per frame. Only used once the Flash-Lite budget is spent.
data_description.ollama_url: Also used as the offline fallback when the Gemini provider is selected.

add_device.title: Add New Device
add_device.description: Scan for and add a new Apple TV or Google TV to the tracker

edit_device.title: Edit {name}
edit_device.description: Configure stream source, audio delay, and content guardrails for this device

data_description.ratings: Select standard ratings to block (e.g., R, TV-MA). If the content matches, it will be skipped.
data_description.tags: Select AI-generated mood tags to block (e.g., Violence, Gore, Nudity).
data_description.custom_tags: Comma-separated specific words or show titles to block (e.g., 'Peppa Pig, Horror').
data_description.delete_device: Check this box and hit Submit to permanently delete this device from the integration.
